create_time.Description:
An RFC3339 timestamp in UTC time. This in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ.
The milliseconds portion (".SSS") is optional.

creator.Description: Output only. Email address of entity that sent original CreateInstance request.

disable_proxy_access.Description: Optional. If true, the workbench instance will not register with the proxy.

effective_labels.Description: All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.

gce_setup.Description: The definition of how to configure a VM instance outside of Resources and Identity.

accelerator_configs.Description:
The hardware accelerators used on this instance. If you use accelerators, make sure that your configuration has
[enough vCPUs and memory to support the 'machine_type' you have selected](https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/gpus/#gpus-list).
Currently supports only one accelerator configuration.

core_count.Description: Optional. Count of cores of this accelerator.

type.Description: Optional. Type of this accelerator. Possible values: ["NVIDIA_TESLA_P100", "NVIDIA_TESLA_V100", "NVIDIA_TESLA_P4", "NVIDIA_TESLA_T4", "NVIDIA_TESLA_A100", "NVIDIA_A100_80GB", "NVIDIA_L4", "NVIDIA_TESLA_T4_VWS", "NVIDIA_TESLA_P100_VWS", "NVIDIA_TESLA_P4_VWS"]

boot_disk.Description: The definition of a boot disk.

disk_encryption.Description:
Optional. Input only. Disk encryption method used on the boot and
data disks, defaults to GMEK. Possible values: ["GMEK", "CMEK"]

disk_size_gb.Description:
Optional. The size of the boot disk in GB attached to this instance,
up to a maximum of 64000 GB (64 TB). If not specified, this defaults to the
recommended value of 150GB.

disk_type.Description: Optional. Indicates the type of the disk. Possible values: ["PD_STANDARD", "PD_SSD", "PD_BALANCED", "PD_EXTREME"]

kms_key.Description:
'Optional. Input only. The KMS key used to encrypt the disks, only
applicable if disk_encryption is CMEK. Format: 'projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/keyRings/{key_ring_id}/cryptoKeys/{key_id}'
Learn more about using your own encryption keys.'

data_disks.Description: Data disks attached to the VM instance. Currently supports only one data disk.

disk_encryption.Description:
Optional. Input only. Disk encryption method used on the boot
and data disks, defaults to GMEK. Possible values: ["GMEK", "CMEK"]

disk_size_gb.Description:
Optional. The size of the disk in GB attached to this VM instance,
up to a maximum of 64000 GB (64 TB). If not specified, this defaults to
100.

disk_type.Description: Optional. Input only. Indicates the type of the disk. Possible values: ["PD_STANDARD", "PD_SSD", "PD_BALANCED", "PD_EXTREME"]

kms_key.Description:
'Optional. Input only. The KMS key used to encrypt the disks,
only applicable if disk_encryption is CMEK. Format: 'projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/keyRings/{key_ring_id}/cryptoKeys/{key_id}'
Learn more about using your own encryption keys.'

disable_public_ip.Description: Optional. If true, no external IP will be assigned to this VM instance.

enable_ip_forwarding.Description:
Optional. Flag to enable ip forwarding or not, default false/off.
https://cloud.google.com/vpc/docs/using-routes#canipforward

machine_type.Description: Optional. The machine type of the VM instance. https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/machine-resource

metadata.Description: Optional. Custom metadata to apply to this instance.

network_interfaces.Description: The network interfaces for the VM. Supports only one interface.

network.Description: Optional. The name of the VPC that this VM instance is in.

nic_type.Description:
Optional. The type of vNIC to be used on this interface. This
may be gVNIC or VirtioNet. Possible values: ["VIRTIO_NET", "GVNIC"]

subnet.Description: Optional. The name of the subnet that this VM instance is in.

service_accounts.Description: The service account that serves as an identity for the VM instance. Currently supports only one service account.

email.Description: Optional. Email address of the service account.

scopes.Description:
Output only. The list of scopes to be made available for this
service account. Set by the CLH to https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform

tags.Description:
Optional. The Compute Engine tags to add to instance (see [Tagging
instances](https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/label-or-tag-resources#tags)).

vm_image.Description:
Definition of a custom Compute Engine virtual machine image for starting
a workbench instance with the environment installed directly on the VM.

family.Description:
Optional. Use this VM image family to find the image; the newest
image in this family will be used.

name.Description: Optional. Use VM image name to find the image.

project.Description:
The name of the Google Cloud project that this VM image belongs to.
Format: {project_id}

health_info.Description:
'Output only. Additional information about instance health. Example:
healthInfo": { "docker_proxy_agent_status": "1", "docker_status": "1", "jupyterlab_api_status":
"-1", "jupyterlab_status": "-1", "updated": "2020-10-18 09:40:03.573409" }'

instance_id.Description: Required. User-defined unique ID of this instance.

instance_owners.Description:
'Optional. Input only. The owner of this instance after creation. Format:
'alias@example.com' Currently supports one owner only. If not specified, all of
the service account users of your VM instance''s service account can use the instance.'

labels.Description:
Optional. Labels to apply to this instance. These can be later modified
by the UpdateInstance method.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

name.Description: The name of this workbench instance. Format: 'projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/instances/{instance_id}'

proxy_uri.Description: Output only. The proxy endpoint that is used to access the Jupyter notebook.

state.Description: Output only. The state of this instance.

terraform_labels.Description:
The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
 and default labels configured on the provider.

update_time.Description:
An RFC3339 timestamp in UTC time. This in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ.
The milliseconds portion (".SSS") is optional.

upgrade_history.Description: Output only. The upgrade history of this instance.

container_image.Description: Optional. The container image before this instance upgrade.

create_time.Description:
An RFC3339 timestamp in UTC time. This in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ.
The milliseconds portion (".SSS") is optional.

framework.Description: Optional. The framework of this workbench instance.

snapshot.Description: Optional. The snapshot of the boot disk of this workbench instance before upgrade.

state.Description: Output only. The state of this instance upgrade history entry.

target_version.Description: Optional. Target VM Version, like m63.

version.Description: Optional. The version of the workbench instance before this upgrade.

vm_image.Description: Optional. The VM image before this instance upgrade.
